{"title":"EDD post-filing: get paid ASAP (monitoring, ID verification readiness, payment setup, certification dates)","content":"## Objective
Ensure your CA EDD claim moves from filed → verified → certified → paid with minimal delays by (1) knowing what to watch for, (2) being ready for identity verification, (3) setting the fastest available payment method, and (4) not missing the first/ongoing biweekly certifications.

## Approach (two axes)
- **Reduce uncertainty first** (EDD payment options + current ID verification flows can change).
- Then **reduce remaining work** by producing a single actionable checklist you can follow daily/weekly until the first payment posts.

## What “done” looks like
- You know exactly where to look in UI Online for notices/certification weeks/payment method.
- You have an ID verification document set ready so you can complete verification the same day if prompted.
- You’ve confirmed whether direct deposit is available *for your claim* (or the fallback debit card path).
